```{r}
# define functions
RPM <- function(x) ((x/sum(x) *1000000) + 1)
average <- function(x,y) ((x + y) /2)
average_3 <- function(x,y,z) ((x + y + z) /3)
L2FC <- function(x,y) (log2(x/y))
zscore <- function(x) ((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
```

```{r}
# Define the correct folder path

# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "./pycroquet_output_A427_ABE", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-`#id`, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna_ids)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
reads_A427 <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

reads_A427 <-
reads_A427 %>%
  rename(A427_BE_plasmid_L1_reads = BE_plasmid_L1_reads) %>%
    rename(A427_BE_plasmid_L2_reads = BE_plasmid_L2_reads)

reads_A427
```

```{r}
#function to sum lanes
collapse_lanes <- function(df, lane_regex = "_L[12]_reads$") {
  # all lane-specific read columns (…_L1_reads or …_L2_reads)
  laned <- names(df) %>% str_subset(lane_regex)
  if (length(laned) == 0) return(df)

  # base sample name without lane suffix
  bases <- str_replace(laned, lane_regex, "")
  groups <- split(laned, bases)  # list: base -> its lane columns

  # make combined columns by summing lanes row-wise
  for (b in names(groups)) {
    cols <- groups[[b]]
    df[[paste0(b, "_reads")]] <- rowSums(df[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # drop original lane columns
  df %>% select(-all_of(laned))
}
```

```{r}
#make a read.tsv files for MAGeCK analysis

# where to save files
out_dir <- "COUNTS"

data %>%
  rename(sgRNA = sgRNA_ID, gene = Gene) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_reads"), as.numeric)) %>%     # ensure numeric (optional)
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("_reads"),
               names_to = "sample_col",
               values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(sample_col, "_reads$")) %>%
  select(sample, sgRNA, gene, reads) %>%
  arrange(sample, gene, sgRNA) %>%
  group_split(sample) %>%
  walk(function(d) {
    s <- unique(d$sample)
    out <- d %>% select(sgRNA, gene, reads)
    names(out)[3] <- s                                    # <-- rename "reads" to sample name
    write_tsv(out, file.path(out_dir, paste0(s, ".read_count.tsv")))
  })
```

```{r}
#read in the MAGeCK analysis

# Define the correct folder path
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "./results/MAGECK_RRA/COMBINED", pattern = "\\.sgrna_summary\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

file_list

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file, key_col = "sgrna") {
  df <- read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # sample name from filename, strip ".sgrna_summary" if present and sanitize
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) |>
    str_remove("\\.sgrna_summary$") |>
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_")

  # rename all non-key columns to "<sample>_<oldname>"
  df %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(sample_name, "_MAGeCK_", .x), .cols = -all_of(key_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
MAGeCK <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "sgrna")

MAGeCK
```

```{r}
data
```

```{r}
#make a replicate versus replicate heatmap for the readcoutns from pycroquet forward

# 1) pick columns: *_pyc_reads AND containing _R1_ or _R2_
read_cols_H23 <- names(data) %>%
  (\(x) x[str_detect(x, "_reads$") & str_detect(x, "_R[123]_") & str_detect(x, "H23")])()

# 2) build pretty labels + ordering (group by sample, then R1/R2)
meta <- tibble(col = read_cols_H23) %>%
  mutate(
    rep = str_match(col, "_R([123])_")[, 2],
    sample = col %>%
      str_replace("_R[123]_", "_") %>%
      str_remove("_reads$"),
    label = paste0(str_replace_all(sample, "_", " "), " R", rep)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, as.integer(rep))

# 3) numeric matrix + correlations
mat <- data %>%
  select(all_of(meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  as.matrix()

cor_mat <- cor(mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# rename rows/cols with pretty labels
colnames(cor_mat) <- meta$label
rownames(cor_mat) <- meta$label

# ---- 4) long form + keep LOWER triangle incl diagonal ----
cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(y = Var1, x = Var2, r = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(x, levels = meta$label),
    y = factor(y, levels = meta$label),
    ix = as.integer(x),
    iy = as.integer(y)
  ) %>%
  filter(iy >= ix)

# 5) plot: diagonal/lower-triangle heatmap
plot1<-ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", sprintf("%.2f", r))), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red",
                      limits = c(0.2, 1.0), oob = squish) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "left") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
plot1
ggsave("prime_reads_Pearson_H23.eps", width = 8, height = 8, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
plot1
ggsave("prime_reads_Pearson_A427.eps", width = 8, height = 8, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
#replicate correlation - H23 - ALL gRNAs
#CTRL
rep1 <-
  data %>%
  select(new_ID, L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp1_zscore) %>%
  distinct()

rep2 <-
  data %>%
  select(new_ID, L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp2_zscore) %>%
  distinct()

rep_correlation <- left_join(rep1, rep2) %>% 
  filter(is.na(L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp1_zscore) ==FALSE & is.na(L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp2_zscore)==FALSE )%>%
  distinct()
r1 <- cor(rep_correlation$L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp1_zscore, rep_correlation$L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_exp2_zscore, method = "pearson")

#RMC
rep1 <-
  data %>%
  select(new_ID, L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp1_zscore) %>%
  distinct()

rep2 <-
  data %>%
  select(new_ID, L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp2_zscore) %>%
  distinct()

rep_correlation <- left_join(rep1, rep2) %>% 
  filter(is.na(L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp1_zscore) ==FALSE & is.na(L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp2_zscore)==FALSE ) %>%
  distinct()
r2 <- cor(rep_correlation$L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp1_zscore, rep_correlation$L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_exp2_zscore, method = "pearson")
```

```{r}
#stats
NT_H23 <- 
  data %>%
  filter(gRNA_class == "non_targeting") %>%
  select(L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore)

se_H23 <- 
data %>%
  filter(gRNA_class == "splice_essential") %>%
  select(L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore)
  
ofl_H23 <- 
data %>%
  filter(gRNA_class == "off_target_lethal") %>%
  select(L2FC_H23_ABE_CTRL_plasmid_average_zscore)

stats1 <- t.test(NT_H23, se_H23, paired = FALSE, alternative = c("two.sided"))
stats2 <- t.test(NT_H23, ofl_H23, paired = FALSE, alternative = c("two.sided"))

# Make a nice label for the plot
p_lab1 <- paste0("italic(P) == ", format(stats1$p.value, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE))
p_lab2 <- paste0("italic(P) == ", format(stats2$p.value, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#BEstimate data - ABE 

# Define the directory path
dir_path <- "/Users/mc32/Documents/Matt_Coelho/Bioinformatics/MAPK_lib/BEstimate_output/ABE"

# Get all relevant file names
file_list <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "_summary_df.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
file_list

# Function to read and rename a file
read_and_rename <- function(file) {
  # Extract prefix from the filename (everything before "_summary_df.csv")
  prefix <- str_remove(basename(file), "_summary_df.csv$")  # Remove the suffix

  # Read the file
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  return(df)
}

# Read and process all files
df_list <- lapply(file_list, read_and_rename)

# Join all data frames by Gene and sgrna
merged_df <- purrr::reduce(df_list, full_join)

# View the result
print(merged_df) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
# BE Coverage Estimation

#read in the protein datafram output csv for BEstimate for CBE and ABE
#these assume a leninet window of bases from 3-9 nt in the gRNA are edited - base editing activity window

#filter CBE data to include only non-synonymous variants with numerical Protein_Position
heat_map <- 
  annotated_data %>%
  select(Gene, guide, Protein_Position, most_severe_consequence) %>%
  distinct() %>%
    separate_rows(Protein_Position, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(Protein_Position = as.numeric(Protein_Position)) %>%
  arrange(Protein_Position) %>%
  filter(most_severe_consequence != "synonymous_variant") %>%
    distinct()

#filter ABE data to include only non-synonymous variants with numerical Protein_Position
heat_map_filtered <- 
  heat_map %>%
  filter(most_severe_consequence != "synonymous_variant") %>%
    distinct()

#print the table
heat_map_filtered

# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 200 residues)
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(Protein_Position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(Protein_Position = as.numeric(Protein_Position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table twith the gRNAs by Protein_Position
KRAS <-
  heat_map_filtered %>%
  filter(Gene == "KRAS")

Coverage <-
  left_join(Protein, KRAS)

#identify the number of missing amino acids (NA gRNA)
Missing <- 
  Coverage %>%
  filter(is.na(guide) == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count()

#calculate the % coverage by non-synonymous amino acid mutations with CBE and ABE
(Length-Missing)/Length*100

#summarise the BE coverage data with a histogram
plot1 <- ggplot(Coverage, aes(x=Protein_Position, fill = most_severe_consequence)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
theme_classic()

#print the plot
plot1
```

```{r}
#heatmap KRAS
annotated_data_2 <- 
  annotated_data %>% 
  select(!c(Protein_Position))

Coverage_2 <- 
  Coverage %>% 
  dplyr::rename(guide = guide) %>%
  select(!c(most_severe_consequence))

Coverage_3 <-
  left_join(Coverage_2, annotated_data_2)

# Filter for the gene of interest
heat_map <- Coverage_3 %>%
  filter(Gene %in% c("KRAS"))

# Select only columns ending in "z_score" and Amino_Acid_Position_simple
df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
select(Protein_Position, ends_with("plasmid_average_zscore")) %>%
  group_by(Protein_Position) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%  # Aggregate duplicates by mean
  arrange(Protein_Position)  # Ensure numeric order

# Convert to matrix and maintain strict column order
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric %>% column_to_rownames("Protein_Position"))

# Ensure columns are in strictly increasing order
df_matrix <- df_matrix[, order(as.numeric(colnames(df_matrix)))] 

# Transpose the matrix so Amino_Acid_Position_simple is on the x-axis
df_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

# Generate the heatmap
plot1 <- pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Prevents automatic column clustering
  cluster_rows = TRUE,  # Ensures rows are not clustered
  show_rownames = TRUE,  # Show row names (z_score columns)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Show column names (Amino_Acid_Position_simple)
  main = "Heatmap of KRAS",
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200),  # Set "RdBu" with 200 color levels
  border_color = NA 
)
plot1
```

```{r}
# make a figure comparing RMC-6236 and ACBI3
plot1 <- ggplot(subset(annotated_data, gRNA_class %in% c("targeting")), aes(x= L2FC_A427_ABE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore, y= L2FC_A427_ABE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore, colour = Gene)) + 
geom_point(position = pos, size = 1, show.legend=FALSE, shape = 1) +
geom_hline(yintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
geom_vline(xintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(L2FC_A427_ABE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_ACBI3_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_ACBI3_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence == "missense" & L2FC_H23_ABE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 | L2FC_A427_ABE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_RMC_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_RMC_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence == "missense" &  L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5, paste(Gene, Protein_Position),
                                 ifelse(L2FC_A427_ABE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_ACBI3_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_ACBI3_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence != "missense" & L2FC_H23_ABE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 | L2FC_A427_ABE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_RMC_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_RMC_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence != "missense" & L2FC_H23_ABE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore > 4.5, paste(Gene, most_severe_consequence),
                                 ""))), size=3, position=pos, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend=FALSE, segment.size = 0.1) +
theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values =c("royalblue", "turquoise3", "orange", "springgreen4", "grey55","brown", "purple", "red","blue1", "black", "pink", "pink", "green", "blue","yellow","orange","magenta","black","purple1","red3","blue","brown","blue3","black","cyan","green4", "salmon")) +
  xlab("A427 ABE: RMC-6236 versus plasmid (z-score)") + ylab("A427 ABE: ACBI3 versus plasmid (z-score)") + 
         labs(colour = NULL) +
  xlim(-10, 20)+
  ylim(-10, 15)
```

```{r}
plot1 <- ggplot(subset(annotated_data, gRNA_class %in% c("targeting")), aes(x= L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp1_zscore, y= L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp2_zscore, colour = Gene)) + 
geom_point(position = pos, size = 1, show.legend=FALSE, shape = 1) +
geom_hline(yintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
geom_vline(xintercept=c(0,0),linetype="dotted") +
geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp1_zscore > 3 & L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp2_zscore > 3 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_MRTX_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_MRTX_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence == "missense", paste(Gene, Protein_Position),
                              ifelse(L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp1_zscore > 3 & L2FC_A427_ABE_MRTX_plasmid_exp2_zscore > 3 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_MRTX_combined_MAGeCK_FDR < 0.1 & plasmid_vs_A427_ABE_MRTX_combined_MAGeCK_p.high < 0.05 & most_severe_consequence != "missense", paste(Gene, most_severe_consequence),
                                 ""))), size=3, position=pos, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend=FALSE, segment.size = 0.1) +
theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values =c("royalblue", "turquoise3", "orange", "springgreen4", "grey55","brown", "purple", "red","blue1", "black", "pink", "pink", "green", "blue","yellow","orange","magenta","black","purple1","red3","blue","brown","blue3","black","cyan","green4", "salmon")) +
  xlab("A427 ABE: MRTX1133 versus plasmid R1 (z-score)") + ylab("A427 ABE: MRTX1133 versus plasmid R2 (z-score)") + 
         labs(colour = NULL) +
  xlim(-10, 20)+
  ylim(-10, 15)
```

```{r}
#merge 3 modalities - Cas9, BE, PE by gene and amino acid position

BE <- as_tibble(read.csv("BE_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))
PE <- as_tibble(read.csv("PE_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))
Cas9 <- as_tibble(read.csv("Cas9_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

BE <- 
  BE %>%
  rename(gene = Gene) %>%
  select(gene, most_severe_consequence, Protein_Position, sgRNA_ID, contains("L2FC")) %>%
  rename(amino_acid_position = Protein_Position) %>%
  distinct()

BE_unnest <- 
  BE %>%
  group_by(gene, amino_acid_position) %>%
 mutate(amino_acid_position = str_trim(amino_acid_position)) %>%   # trim spaces
  separate_rows(amino_acid_position, sep = ";", convert = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct()

PE <- 
  PE %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, mutation, contains("L2FC"))

Cas9 <- 
  Cas9 %>%
  select(!c(X)) %>%
  select(-matches("(?i)(goodsgrna_|num_)"))

BE %>%colnames()
PE %>%colnames()
Cas9 %>%colnames()

BE
PE
Cas9
```

```{r}
#join dataframes

multi_modal <- left_join(BE_unnest, Cas9)
multi_modal <- full_join(multi_modal, PE) 

multi_modal_BE_nested <- left_join(BE, Cas9)
```

```{r}
#make a figure of the selected genes
graphing_subset <- 
  multi_modal_BE_nested %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("KRAS", "FGFR1", "PPIA", "VHL")) %>%
  select(gene, sgRNA_ID, amino_acid_position, amino_acid_position_simple, most_severe_consequence, contains(c("average_zscore", "neg.lfc_MAGeCK"))) %>%
  select(!c("neg.lfc_MAGeCK_Control_T0")) %>%
  distinct()

id_cols <- c("sgRNA_ID", "gene","amino_acid_position","amino_acid_position_simple", "most_severe_consequence") %>% 
  intersect(names(graphing_subset))

long_zscore <- graphing_subset %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^L2FC_(?:H23|A427)_.+_zscore$"),
    names_to = c("cell", "editor", "drug"),
    names_pattern = "^L2FC_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_.+_zscore$",
    values_to = "zscore",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # create one column per cell line: H23_zscore, A427_zscore
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cell,
    values_from = zscore,
    names_glue  = "{cell}_zscore"
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(id_cols), drug, H23_zscore, A427_zscore) %>%
  filter(!is.na(amino_acid_position)) %>%
  distinct()

long_mageck <- graphing_subset %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("neg.lfc_MAGeCK_"),
    names_to = "key",
    values_to = "MAGeCK_LFC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    drug = str_remove(key, "^neg\\.lfc_MAGeCK_")  # directly derive drug
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(id_cols), drug, MAGeCK_LFC) %>%
  filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == FALSE) %>%
  distinct()

long_zscore <-
  long_zscore %>%
  mutate(drug =  ifelse(drug == "BI", "BI-2865", 
                                     ifelse(drug == "CTRL", "control", 
                                            ifelse(drug == "RMC", "RMC-6236", 
                                                   ifelse(drug == "MRTX", "MRTX1133", drug)))))

long_mageck <-
  long_mageck %>%
 mutate(drug =  ifelse(drug == "BI2865", "BI-2865", 
                                     ifelse(drug == "Control_plasmid", "control", 
                                            ifelse(drug == "RMC6236", "RMC-6236", 
                                                   ifelse(drug == "A3BI3", "ACBI3", drug)))))

#join the zscores and mageck Cas9 scores together
long_tbl <- 
  left_join(long_zscore, long_mageck)
```

```{r}
#filter for the interesting conditions with both cell lines
long_tbl <- 
  long_tbl %>%
  filter(drug %in% c("control", "RMC-6236", "ACBI3"))

#sepcify condition order
long_tbl <- long_tbl %>%
  mutate(drug = fct_relevel(drug, "control", "RMC-6236", "ACBI3"))
```

```{r}
#FGFR1 zscores of pymol - minimum value of A427 zscore
Length <- 822
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))
  
FGFR1 <-
  long_tbl %>%
  filter(gene == "FGFR1") %>%
  filter(drug == "control") %>%
  select(sgRNA_ID, amino_acid_position, A427_zscore) %>%
  separate_rows(amino_acid_position, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position)) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid_position) %>%
  summarise(minimum = min(A427_zscore)) %>%
    arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  distinct()

#left join and impute NAs
FGFR1 <- 
  left_join(Protein, FGFR1) %>%
  mutate(minimum = ifelse(is.na(minimum), 0, minimum))

FGFR1 

#write a pymol score sheet 
FGFR1 %>%
  select(minimum) %>%
  write_tsv("FGFR1_Bscores.txt")
```

```{r}
# BE Coverage Estimation

# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 200 residues)
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table twith the gRNAs by Protein_Position
KRAS <-
  multi_modal %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS")

Coverage <-
  left_join(Protein, KRAS)

#summarise the BE coverage data with a histogram

geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
theme_classic()

#print the plot
plot1
```

```{r}
#heatmap KRAS with missing values
all_pos <- seq(min(heat_map$Protein_Position, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(heat_map$Protein_Position, na.rm = TRUE))

df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
  mutate(Protein_Position = as.integer(Protein_Position)) %>%
  select(Protein_Position, ends_with("_average_zscore")) %>%
  group_by(Protein_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)  # keep NA if all missing
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(Protein_Position = all_pos) %>%   # <-- ensure missing positions are present as NA
  arrange(Protein_Position)

# Matrix (positions as columns after transpose)
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric %>% column_to_rownames("Protein_Position"))
df_matrix <- df_matrix[, order(as.numeric(colnames(df_matrix))), drop = FALSE]
df_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

# Heatmap with explicit NA colour
plot1 <- pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey85",  # <-- colour for NA cells
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200),
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Heatmap of KRAS"
)
plot1
```

```{r}
#heatmap KRAS for Y64 only
heat_map <-
  annotated_data %>%
  select(Gene, guide, sgRNA_ID, Protein_Position, most_severe_consequence, contains("_zscore")) %>%
  filter(Gene == "KRAS") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Protein_Position, "64")) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Protein_Position, "164") == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(id = paste(Protein_Position, sgRNA_ID)) %>%
  select(id,  contains("_average_zscore")) %>%
    distinct()

# Matrix (positions as columns after transpose)
df_matrix <- as.matrix(heat_map %>% column_to_rownames("id"))
df_matrix <- df_matrix[, order(as.numeric(colnames(df_matrix))), drop = FALSE]
df_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

# Make colour scale symmetric around 0
max_val <- max(abs(df_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)          # largest |z|
breaks  <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 201)   # 200 intervals
cols    <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200)

# Heatmap 
plot1 <- pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey85",
  color = cols,
  breaks = breaks,          # <- this centres at 0
  border_color = NA,
  main = "", 
)
plot1
```
